definition: The information system displays an organization-defined system use notification message or banner before granting access.
The information system retains the notification message or banner on the screen until users acknowledge the usage conditions.
The information system initiates a session lock after an organization-defined time period of inactivity.
The information system implements cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions.
The organization implements the security configuration settings.
The information system implements multifactor authentication for network access to privileged accounts.
The information system protects the authenticity of communications sessions.
The organization allocates audit record storage capacity in accordance with organization-defined audit record storage requirements.
The information system protects the confidentiality and/or integrity of transmitted information.
